description: Keeps a build packet's claim only while the agent works on it: after each tool call that touches the claim's worktree (or once the worktree changed), retain packet heartbeat renews the claim this agent session holds, at most once every 5 minutes; when the session ends, it releases them.

hooks.command: r="$(command -v retain 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$HOME/.local/bin/retain")"; [ -x "$r" ] && "$r" packet heartbeat --stdin >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
r="$(command -v retain 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$HOME/.local/bin/retain")"; [ -x "$r" ] && "$r" packet heartbeat --stdin --release >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
